name: Hangout Plaza
how: Pick a color and a hat, then stroll around a little plaza with a fountain, benches and trees. Chat in speech bubbles, wave, dance, jump or sit on a bench.
controls: WASD or tap the ground to walk, drag to look around, Enter to chat, 1 to 4 or the 😀 button for emotes
uses: Everyone walks, chats and emotes in the same plaza at once.
Friendly bots wander, sit, dance and say hi until people arrive.
Mute anyone from the people list; it hides their chat on your screen.
ideas: Add a dance floor with music
Add more hats and a shop to buy them
Add a mini game in one corner
